title: Nazar Andaaz
overview: Sudhir, blind by birth, lives alone with his housemaid Bhavani. While Bhavani is out, he takes in Ali to help around the house. Both Bhavani and Ali grow envious of each other. Nazar Andaaz is a comedic yet heartfelt story of these three.
